description: DELETE a LINK between two backlog items — the UI's Linkages delete (the opposite of backlog_link). Pass the item that owns the link (`sourceType` + `sourceId`, e.g. epic EP-71) and the item it points to (`destType` + `destId`, e.g. defect DE-2293). If the source has more than one link to that item, say which with `linkType` (e.g. "Clones"). The link disappears from BOTH items' Linkages; the tool reads the source's Linkages back to confirm and checks the other side too. A link that is not there is reported with the links the source does have. Deleting is final — call it only when the user asked to remove the link.

destId.description: The linked item's id or business key (DE-2293).

linkType.description: Link type name or key (e.g. "Clones") — needed only when the source has several links to that item.

sourceId.description: Source item id or business key (EP-71, FT-266, US-1326, DE-2293, TA-3).

sourceType.description: Item type that owns the Linkages row.

name: backlog_unlink
title: Remove a link between two backlog items (Linkages)
